query: How does pdfminer's command-line dump tool print a document's outline (its bookmarks): how does it map each entry to a page number, how does it deal with destinations given as names, references or actions, and what happens when the document has no outline?

operations.name: A table from page object ids to page numbers is built first
Named destinations are looked up in the document, whether given as a string or a literal
A dictionary destination is unwrapped to its D entry
A GoTo action supplies the destination when there is no direct one
expressions: if subtype and repr(subtype) == "/'GoTo'" and action.get("D"):

operations.name: A document without an outline is handled silently

dependencies.name: Actions are only consulted when an entry has no direct destination
Indirect object references are resolved to the object they point to
The destination and the page number are written only when they were found
Titles are escaped before they are written into the XML attribute
